approach.en: Windows build of the Xbox version
approach.zh: 在 Windows 上跑 Xbox 版

note.en: PC Games Hardware: steers the prologue on an RTX 3050 at single-digit fps. Not a playable game.
note.zh: PC Games Hardware：在 RTX 3050 上以个位数帧率操控序章。还不是能玩的游戏。

en: PC Games Hardware reports character control through the prologue
The reported test PC used a GeForce RTX 3050
zh: PC Games Hardware 报道可以操控角色走过序章
报道中的测试机是 GeForce RTX 3050

en: Frame rate is only described as single-digit
Picture quality and session length were not independently measured
Still needs leaked console files, which this site does not link
zh: 帧率只被描述为个位数
画面质量和能跑多久，没有独立测量
仍然依赖泄露的主机文件，本站不提供链接

approach.zh: 直接在 Windows 跑 Xbox 代码

note.en: PC Games Hardware: the world loads. Earlier notes: menus near 30 fps, dark world, crashes within about a minute.
note.zh: PC Games Hardware：世界能加载。更早的公开记录：菜单约 30 帧，世界画面昏暗，大约 1 分钟内崩溃。

en: Named by PC Games Hardware on 24 Nov as loading the game world
Earlier public notes put the menus near 30 fps
zh: 11 月 24 日被 PC Games Hardware 点名为能加载游戏世界
更早的公开记录称菜单约 30 帧

en: No outlet has confirmed player control on this build
Earlier notes describe a dark world and a crash within about a minute
zh: 还没有媒体证实这个版本能操控角色
更早的记录是世界画面昏暗，大约 1 分钟内崩溃

claims.en: A separate clip of a lit scene at about 3 fps has not been confirmed.
claims.zh: 另有一段约 3 帧的亮场景片段，尚未证实。

note.en: PC Games Hardware: the world loads. Earlier notes: menus near a steady 30 fps, gameplay not reached.
note.zh: PC Games Hardware：世界能加载。更早的记录：菜单大约稳定 30 帧，还没进入可玩状态。

en: Named by PC Games Hardware on 24 Nov as loading the game world
Earlier notes: menus held near 30 fps
zh: 11 月 24 日被 PC Games Hardware 点名为能加载游戏世界
更早的记录：菜单大约 30 帧

en: No reputable report of character control
Earlier notes stopped short of gameplay
zh: 还没有权威报道称可以操控角色
更早的记录停在可玩状态之前

note.en: Project notes: stays in the world about 5 minutes, screen black, 0.3–0.5 fps. Not re-checked by an outlet since 24 Nov.
note.zh: 项目记录：能在世界里停留约 5 分钟，黑屏，0.3–0.5 帧。11 月 24 日之后没有媒体复核。

en: Project notes say the world stays loaded for about 5 minutes
zh: 项目记录称世界能保持加载约 5 分钟

en: The same notes say the screen is black at 0.3–0.5 fps
Not confirmed by a news outlet
zh: 同一份记录称画面全黑，0.3–0.5 帧
没有新闻媒体证实

note.en: Project notes: world frames are a flat colour and take 18 seconds to 2 minutes each. Not re-checked by an outlet.
note.zh: 项目记录：世界画面是一片纯色，每帧要 18 秒到 2 分钟。没有媒体复核。

en: Project notes say world frames are being produced
zh: 项目记录称已经能输出世界画面

en: Frames are described as a flat colour
Each frame is reported at 18 seconds to 2 minutes
zh: 画面被描述成一片纯色
每帧据称要 18 秒到 2 分钟

note.en: Project notes: first-run screens appear; loading the story hits memory corruption.
note.zh: 项目记录：首次启动界面能出现；读取剧情时内存损坏。

en: Project notes say the first-run screens appear
zh: 项目记录称首次启动界面能出现

en: Story load is reported to hit memory corruption
No outlet has confirmed this build
zh: 读取剧情据称会内存损坏
没有媒体证实这个版本

note.en: Project notes: intro video with sound at about 30 fps. Gameplay not reported.
note.zh: 项目记录：开场视频带声音，约 30 帧。没有可玩的报道。

en: Project notes say the intro video plays with sound near 30 fps
zh: 项目记录称开场视频带声音，约 30 帧

en: No reported character control
Not re-checked by an outlet
zh: 没有操控角色的报道
没有媒体复核

note.en: Project notes: setup screens. Screenshots were withdrawn.
note.zh: 项目记录：到设置界面。截图已撤下。

en: Project notes say setup screens appear
zh: 项目记录称能到设置界面

en: Screenshots were withdrawn
No world or character control reported
zh: 截图已撤下
没有世界或操控角色的报道

note.en: Project notes: intro and setup on an RTX 4060 laptop. Not re-checked by an outlet.
note.zh: 项目记录：RTX 4060 笔记本上到开场和设置。没有媒体复核。

en: Project notes say intro and setup run on an RTX 4060 laptop
zh: 项目记录称 RTX 4060 笔记本上能到开场和设置

en: No reported gameplay
A single laptop note, not an outlet test
zh: 没有可玩的报道
只是一份笔记本记录，不是媒体测试

note.en: Project notes: UI and a 4K intro on a GTX 1650 Ti.
note.zh: 项目记录：GTX 1650 Ti 上跑出界面和 4K 开场。

en: Project notes say the UI and a 4K intro appear on a GTX 1650 Ti
zh: 项目记录称 GTX 1650 Ti 上能出界面和 4K 开场

en: No world or character control in the notes
Not re-checked by an outlet
zh: 记录里没有世界或操控角色
没有媒体复核

note.en: Project notes: a player-select prompt on Linux. Gameplay not reported.
note.zh: 项目记录：Linux 上出现选择玩家的提示。没有可玩的报道。

en: Project notes say a player-select prompt appears on Linux
zh: 项目记录称 Linux 上能出现选择玩家的提示

en: No gameplay reported
Not re-checked by an outlet
zh: 没有可玩的报道
没有媒体复核

note.en: Project notes: a start-screen prompt. Nothing past that is described.
note.zh: 项目记录：开始界面的提示条。没有更远的描述。

en: Project notes say a start-screen prompt appears
zh: 项目记录称能显示开始界面的提示

en: No world or gameplay described
Not re-checked by an outlet
zh: 没有世界或可玩的描述
没有媒体复核

note.en: Offline. A Take-Two DMCA notice dated 24 Nov removed the project and 3,007 repositories in its network.
note.zh: 已下线。Take-Two 日期为 11 月 24 日的 DMCA 通知，移除了该项目及其网络中的 3007 个仓库。

en: heise, The Verge and ComputerBase report the DMCA notice and the 3,007-repository removal
zh: heise、The Verge、ComputerBase 报道了这份 DMCA 通知和 3007 个仓库的移除

en: The project is offline
The founder had already stepped away
Earlier technical notes never got past first frames
zh: 项目已下线
创始人此前已经退出
更早的技术记录没有超过出帧

note.en: Project notes: first frames, nothing visible yet.
note.zh: 项目记录：能出帧，但还看不到内容。

en: Project notes say frames are produced
zh: 项目记录称已经能出帧

en: Nothing visible is described
Early, and not re-checked by an outlet
zh: 记录里还看不到内容
仍处于早期，没有媒体复核

note.en: Project notes: a game window only, with no further updates noted after 23 Nov.
note.zh: 项目记录：只到游戏窗口，23 日之后没有再看到更新。

en: Project notes say a game window opens
zh: 项目记录称能打开游戏窗口

en: Nothing is drawn, according to the notes
Quiet since 23 Nov
zh: 记录称窗口里没有画面
11 月 23 日之后没有动静
